items.name: Perplexity
items.why: Today’s Nvidia partnership and Portable Computer / local GPU-agent launch create an immediate inference-runtime buying window, and Reo shows High intent with 53 events and 12 active developers in 90 days.
items.message: Aravind — congrats on the Nvidia partnership and the Portable Computer launch. Moving a fully local agent onto user GPUs with a zero-token positioning puts a lot of pressure on compile/runtime performance, memory layout, and consistent latency across heterogeneous devices—areas where cloud-only stacks usually break down. Modular’s MAX inference engine is built for exactly that: high-throughput, portable serving when you need production-grade GPU inference without ballooning cost as surface area expands. If useful, I can share a short briefing on how teams running agentic search/local models tighten time-to-first-token and GPU utilization, and we can map it against your Sonar/frontier routing path. Open to a 20-minute working session this week?

items.name: Skild AI
items.why: Yesterday’s $1.4B Series C at a $14B valuation to build a universal robot brain is an exceptional new-logo capital trigger for compute-heavy VLA training and serving.
items.message: Deepak — the $1.4B Series C and $14B valuation to build a universal brain for robots is a clear inflection for Skild’s infra footprint. Generalist VLA workloads tend to explode both training iteration cost and on-robot/edge inference latency as you broaden embodiment coverage. Modular’s MAX stack is designed to cut serving cost and raise throughput for foundation-model inference without locking you into a single accelerator path. Happy to walk through how robotics labs typically stage research clusters into production serving, and what a first MAX benchmark on your current stack would look like. Would a brief call with whoever owns inference/platform this week be useful?

items.message: Jason / Eiso — the Nvidia licensing partnership at multi-billion scale, alongside the new raise, implies Poolside will be standing up and iterating code models much faster. That usually surfaces hard constraints on serving latency, throughput per GPU, and cost as evaluation and customer workloads ramp. If helpful, we can run a focused review of your current serving path and where MAX would most improve tokens/sec and $/token. Open to a short technical conversation this week with the infra owners?

items.message: Ilya / Daniel — with SSI’s first model reportedly imminent after the Nvidia partnership and capital infusion, the next bottleneck is usually research-to-production serving: reliable latency, efficient GPU use, and a path from experimental runs to repeatable inference. items.message: Prem — congratulations on the $76M raise with Universal, Warner, and Sony.
